source.original_text: For a standard Gaussian row Z in dimension r=q+1, put R=||Z||^2. In the standing range 2q+1<d, Gaussian fourth moments give E[R Z Z^T]=(r+2)I_r. Off-diagonal entries vanish by sign symmetry, and every diagonal entry equals 3+(r-1)=r+2.

blind_reconstruction.text:
For every pair of natural numbers d and q satisfying 2q + 1 < d, set n = q + 1 and let r be the real number n. Let E be real Euclidean n-space, with its Euclidean norm and Borel structure, and let μ be the standard centered Gaussian probability measure on E: its coordinates in an orthonormal basis are independent real Gaussian variables of mean zero and variance one.

For x = (x_i) with i in Fin(n), define R(x) = ‖x‖₂², the real n-by-n matrix G(x) by G(x)_{ij} = x_i x_j, and the real n-by-n matrix W(x) = R(x) G(x). Thus W(x)_{ij} = ‖x‖₂² x_i x_j. Scalar multiplication here multiplies every matrix entry. Equip the matrix space with the operator norm induced by the Euclidean norm on real n-space, and with its usual finite-dimensional topology.

The conclusion is the conjunction of the following two assertions for these same E, μ, and W:

1. W is Bochner integrable with respect to μ: it is μ-almost everywhere strongly measurable and ∫_E ‖W(x)‖op dμ(x) < ∞. In this case ‖W(x)‖op = ‖x‖₂⁴, so the norm-integrability assertion is finiteness of the Gaussian fourth norm moment.
2. Its real Bochner integral is exactly

   ∫_E W(x) dμ(x) = (r + 2) I_n = (q + 3) I_n,

   where I_n is the n-by-n identity matrix. Equivalently, for every i,j in Fin(n),

   ∫_E ‖x‖₂² x_i x_j dμ(x) = q + 3 if i = j, and 0 if i ≠ j.

The integral is with respect to the Gaussian probability measure μ, not unweighted Lebesgue measure. Integrability is asserted in the matrix operator norm, rather than merely asserted separately for entries. The integral is the real Bochner integral. Although the supplied definition context gives it a zero default on nonintegrable functions, the explicit integrability conclusion makes that default irrelevant here.

All quantifiers and parameter cases are as follows. The statement is universal in natural d and q and in a witness of 2q + 1 < d; it has no additional hypotheses. This integer inequality is equivalent to d ≥ 2q + 2, so equality d = 2q + 2 is allowed. The symbol d does not determine the dimension of E and does not occur in W, μ, or the resulting constant. The only displayed multiplicative constant is exactly n + 2 = q + 3; it depends on q through n and is independent of d. There is no unspecified constant or further parameter dependence.

The boundary case q = 0 is included: n = 1, admissibility is d ≥ 2, W(x) is the one-by-one matrix with entry x⁴, and its integral under the real standard Gaussian probability law is the one-by-one matrix with entry 3. There is no zero-dimensional case because q + 1 ≥ 1. The values d = 0 and d = 1 admit no q satisfying the hypothesis, and the theorem asserts no case-specific conclusion for a pair that fails the hypothesis. The definition of W includes x = 0, where W(0) = 0, without any nonzero-vector assumption.

There is no unresolved ambiguity for the objects or integrability sense once the supplied approved definition context is used. No hypothesis on d or q beyond their natural-number domains and the displayed strict inequality is added.

/-!
# The radial fourth matrix moment of a standard Gaussian row

Appendix C.2 Ex113 evaluates the unnormalized weighted second-moment matrix.
Its integrability and all scalar fourth and mixed moments are internal.
-/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory WithLp
open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumRadialFourthMoment

theorem actual_radial_fourth_moment_matrix
    {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) :
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let μ : Measure E := stdGaussian E
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let R : E → ℝ := fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2
  let G : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun x => Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp x)
  let weighted : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun x => R x • G x
  Integrable weighted μ ∧
    (∫ x, weighted x ∂μ) = (r + 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let μ : Measure E := stdGaussian E
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let R : E → ℝ := fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2
  let G : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun x => Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp x)
  let weighted : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun x => R x • G x
  let entry (i j : Fin (q + 1)) (x : E) : ℝ := R x * (x i * x j)
  have radius_four_integrable : Integrable (fun x : E => ‖x‖ ^ 4) μ :=
    (IsGaussian.memLp_id μ 4 (by norm_num)).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
  have entry_integrable (i j : Fin (q + 1)) : Integrable (entry i j) μ := by
    have entry_continuous : Continuous (entry i j) := by
      exact (continuous_norm.pow 2).mul
        ((PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => ℝ) i).mul
          (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => ℝ) j))
    apply radius_four_integrable.mono' entry_continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards with x
    calc
      ‖entry i j x‖ = R x * (‖x i‖ * ‖x j‖) := by
        simp [entry, R, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ R x * (‖x‖ * ‖x‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul (PiLp.norm_apply_le x i) (PiLp.norm_apply_le x j)
            (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖x‖ ^ 4 := by dsimp [R]; ring
  let rows : E → Fin (q + 1) → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun x i j => entry i j x
  have rows_integrable : Integrable rows μ :=
    Integrable.of_eval (fun i => Integrable.of_eval (fun j => entry_integrable i j))
  let ofRows : (Fin (q + 1) → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ]
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    (Matrix.ofLinearEquiv ℝ).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have weighted_integrable : Integrable weighted μ := by
    change Integrable (fun x => ofRows (rows x)) μ
    exact ofRows.toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp rows_integrable
  have integral_entry (i j : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∫ x, weighted x ∂μ) i j = ∫ x, entry i j x ∂μ := by
    have transport := ofRows.integral_comp_comm rows (μ := μ)
    change (∫ x, weighted x ∂μ) = ofRows (∫ x, rows x ∂μ) at transport
    rw [transport]
    change ((∫ x, rows x ∂μ) i) j = _
    rw [MeasureTheory.eval_integral (fun i => rows_integrable.eval i) i]
    exact MeasureTheory.eval_integral (fun j => entry_integrable i j) j

  -- A coordinate reflection preserves the law and radius, and negates an off-diagonal entry.
  have off_diagonal (i j : Fin (q + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
      (∫ x, entry i j x ∂μ) = 0 := by
    let flip : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E :=
      LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrRight 2 fun k : Fin (q + 1) =>
        if k = i then LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ else LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ
    have flip_apply (x : E) (k : Fin (q + 1)) :
        flip x k = if k = i then -x k else x k := by
      change (if k = i then (LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ : ℝ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ℝ)
        else LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ) (x k) = _
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    have flip_entry (x : E) : entry i j (flip x) = -entry i j x := by
      have radius_eq : R (flip x) = R x := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) (flip.norm_map x)
      simp only [entry, radius_eq, flip_apply]
      simp [hij.symm]
    have law : Measure.map flip μ = μ := stdGaussian_map flip
    have integrand_measurable : AEStronglyMeasurable (entry i j) (Measure.map flip μ) := by
      rw [law]
      exact (entry_integrable i j).aestronglyMeasurable
    have transport := integral_map flip.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable integrand_measurable
    rw [law] at transport
    simp_rw [flip_entry] at transport
    rw [integral_neg] at transport
    linarith

  -- The canonical coordinate pushforward exposes the independent scalar Gaussian laws.
  let ν : Measure (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) := Measure.pi (fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1)
  have law : Measure.map (toLp 2) ν = μ := map_pi_eq_stdGaussian
  have pullback (f : E → ℝ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) :
      (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∫ u, f (toLp 2 u) ∂ν := by
    have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable f (Measure.map (toLp 2) ν) := by rwa [law]
    have transport := integral_map (φ := toLp 2) (μ := ν) (by fun_prop) hm
    rwa [law] at transport
  have scalar_integrable (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun t : ℝ => t ^ n) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    have interior_point : (0 : ℝ) ∈ interior (integrableExpSet id (gaussianReal 0 1)) := by
      simp [integrableExpSet_id_gaussianReal]
    simpa only [Pi.pow_apply, id_eq] using
      integrable_pow_of_mem_interior_integrableExpSet interior_point n
  have coordinate_integrable (i : Fin (q + 1)) (n : ℕ) :
      Integrable (fun u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ => (u i) ^ n) ν :=
    (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1) i).integrable_comp_of_integrable
      (scalar_integrable n)
  have scalar_second : (∫ t : ℝ, t ^ 2 ∂gaussianReal 0 1) = 1 := by
    have moment := variance_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1)
    rw [variance_eq_integral (by fun_prop)] at moment
    simpa only [integral_id_gaussianReal, sub_zero, id_eq, NNReal.coe_one] using moment
  have coordinate_second (i : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∫ u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ, (u i) ^ 2 ∂ν) = 1 := by
    change (∫ u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ, (u i) ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1)) = 1
    rw [integral_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1)
      (i := i) (f := fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) (scalar_integrable 2).aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact scalar_second
  have coordinate_fourth (i : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∫ u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ, (u i) ^ 4 ∂ν) = 3 := by
    change (∫ u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ, (u i) ^ 4 ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1)) = 3
    rw [integral_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1)
      (i := i) (f := fun t : ℝ => t ^ 4) (scalar_integrable 4).aestronglyMeasurable]
    simpa using
      AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.GaussianFourthMoment.integral_pow_four_gaussianReal_zero 1
  have independent_squares :
      iIndepFun (fun i : Fin (q + 1) => fun u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ => (u i) ^ 2) ν :=
    iIndepFun_pi (X := fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) (fun _ => by fun_prop)
  have mixed_integrable (k i : Fin (q + 1)) :
      Integrable (fun u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ => (u k) ^ 2 * (u i) ^ 2) ν := by
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst k
      convert coordinate_integrable i 4 using 1
      funext u
      ring
    · exact (independent_squares.indepFun hki).integrable_mul
        (coordinate_integrable k 2) (coordinate_integrable i 2)
  have mixed_value (k i : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∫ u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ, (u k) ^ 2 * (u i) ^ 2 ∂ν) =
        if k = i then 3 else 1 := by
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst k
      simp only [ite_true]
      simpa only [← pow_add] using coordinate_fourth i
    · rw [(independent_squares.indepFun hki).integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral
        (coordinate_integrable k 2).aestronglyMeasurable
        (coordinate_integrable i 2).aestronglyMeasurable, coordinate_second, coordinate_second]
      simp [hki]
  have diagonal_value (i : Fin (q + 1)) : (∫ x, entry i i x ∂μ) = r + 2 := by
    have entry_expansion (u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
        entry i i (toLp 2 u) = ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (u k) ^ 2 * (u i) ^ 2 := by
      change ‖(toLp 2 u : E)‖ ^ 2 * (u i * u i) = _
      rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
      change (∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (u k) ^ 2) * (u i * u i) = _
      simp only [Finset.sum_mul, pow_two]
    calc
      (∫ x, entry i i x ∂μ) = ∫ u, ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (u k) ^ 2 * (u i) ^ 2 ∂ν := by
        rw [pullback _ (entry_integrable i i).aestronglyMeasurable]
        simp_rw [entry_expansion]
      _ = ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), ∫ u, (u k) ^ 2 * (u i) ^ 2 ∂ν :=
        integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => mixed_integrable k i)
      _ = ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), if k = i then (3 : ℝ) else 1 := by simp_rw [mixed_value]
      _ = ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), ((if k = i then (2 : ℝ) else 0) + 1) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        split_ifs <;> norm_num
      _ = r + 2 := by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, r]; ring
  refine ⟨weighted_integrable, ?_⟩
  change (∫ x, weighted x ∂μ) = (r + 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ)
  ext i j
  rw [integral_entry]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simpa using diagonal_value i
  · simpa [hij] using off_diagonal i j

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumRadialFourthMoment

candidate_publication_context.statement: A standard Gaussian row in dimension \(r\) satisfies \(\mathbb E[\|Z\|^2ZZ^\top]=(r+2)I_r\).
assumptions: Let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\), \(2q+1<d\), and \(r=q+1\). The case \(q=0\) has \(r=1\).
The row has the canonical standard Gaussian law \(Z\sim N(0,I_r)\) on real Euclidean space. Put \(R=\|Z\|^2\).

For each fixed row \(i\), use \(\theta_j=(j-\tfrac12)\pi/d\) and \(t_j=(1,\sqrt2\cos\theta_j,\ldots,\sqrt2\cos(q\theta_j))\). Lean row \(i\in\mathrm{Fin}(d)\) corresponds to source row \(j=i.val+1\), and feature frequencies are \(0,\ldots,q\).
The truncation uses the closed event \(R\le L\), where \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\). The feature length is \(\|t_i\|^2=\sum_{k=0}^q t_i[k]^2\).

Both matrix integrability assertions are proved conclusions in the Euclidean operator norm. Expectations use the original Gaussian probability measure, and \(\preceq\) is the positive semidefinite order.

steps.title: Cancel the off-diagonal entries

steps.title: Evaluate the diagonal fourth and mixed moments
steps.text: Transport the canonical Gaussian to its product-coordinate realization. Scalar Gaussian moments give the second moment one and fourth moment three, and independence gives each distinct-coordinate mixed square moment one. Expand the radius in each diagonal entry and combine all entries. The mixed sum is empty when r=1.

    have interior_point : (0 : ℝ) ∈ interior (integrableExpSet id (gaussianReal 0 1)) := by

    rw [integral_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1)
      (i := i) (f := fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) (scalar_integrable 2).aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact scalar_second
  have coordinate_fourth (i : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∫ u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ, (u i) ^ 4 ∂ν) = 3 := by
    change (∫ u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ, (u i) ^ 4 ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1)) = 3
    rw [integral_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => gaussianReal 0 1)
      (i := i) (f := fun t : ℝ => t ^ 4) (scalar_integrable 4).aestronglyMeasurable]
    simpa using
      AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.GaussianFourthMoment.integral_pow_four_gaussianReal_zero 1
  have independent_squares :
      iIndepFun (fun i : Fin (q + 1) => fun u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ => (u i) ^ 2) ν :=
    iIndepFun_pi (X := fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) (fun _ => by fun_prop)
  have mixed_integrable (k i : Fin (q + 1)) :
      Integrable (fun u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ => (u k) ^ 2 * (u i) ^ 2) ν := by
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst k
      convert coordinate_integrable i 4 using 1
      funext u
      ring
    · exact (independent_squares.indepFun hki).integrable_mul
        (coordinate_integrable k 2) (coordinate_integrable i 2)
  have mixed_value (k i : Fin (q + 1)) :
      (∫ u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ, (u k) ^ 2 * (u i) ^ 2 ∂ν) =
        if k = i then 3 else 1 := by
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst k
      simp only [ite_true]
      simpa only [← pow_add] using coordinate_fourth i
    · rw [(independent_squares.indepFun hki).integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral
        (coordinate_integrable k 2).aestronglyMeasurable
        (coordinate_integrable i 2).aestronglyMeasurable, coordinate_second, coordinate_second]
      simp [hki]
  have diagonal_value (i : Fin (q + 1)) : (∫ x, entry i i x ∂μ) = r + 2 := by
    have entry_expansion (u : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
        entry i i (toLp 2 u) = ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (u k) ^ 2 * (u i) ^ 2 := by
      change ‖(toLp 2 u : E)‖ ^ 2 * (u i * u i) = _
      rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
      change (∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (u k) ^ 2) * (u i * u i) = _
      simp only [Finset.sum_mul, pow_two]
    calc
      (∫ x, entry i i x ∂μ) = ∫ u, ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (u k) ^ 2 * (u i) ^ 2 ∂ν := by
        rw [pullback _ (entry_integrable i i).aestronglyMeasurable]
        simp_rw [entry_expansion]
      _ = ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), ∫ u, (u k) ^ 2 * (u i) ^ 2 ∂ν :=
        integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => mixed_integrable k i)
      _ = ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), if k = i then (3 : ℝ) else 1 := by simp_rw [mixed_value]
      _ = ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), ((if k = i then (2 : ℝ) else 0) + 1) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        split_ifs <;> norm_num
      _ = r + 2 := by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, r]; ring
  refine ⟨weighted_integrable, ?_⟩
  change (∫ x, weighted x ∂μ) = (r + 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ)
  ext i j
  rw [integral_entry]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simpa using diagonal_value i
  · simpa [hij] using off_diagonal i j

steps.title: Square the actual truncated tensor summand
steps.text: Apply the rank-one square identities to the Gaussian and deterministic feature matrices, and use Kronecker multiplication and indicator idempotence. Tensoring the integrable weighted matrix through a fixed continuous linear map proves integrability of the actual square. This fold includes the complete private statement and its algebraic setup.
steps.lean:
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumRadialFourthMoment
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Kronecker
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Integral

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped Matrix.Norms.L2Operator
open AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumRadialFourthMoment
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityFixedSpectrumRadialFourthMoment

private theorem actual_truncated_summand_second_moment_bound
    {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) (i : Fin d) :
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let μ : Measure E := stdGaussian E
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let R : E → ℝ := fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun j => ((j.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun j k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ j)
  let G : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    fun x => Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp x)
  let feature : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)
  let Y : E → Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    Set.indicator {y : E | R y ≤ L}
      (fun x => (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (G x) feature)
  let squared := fun x => Y x * Y x
  let upper : Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ :=
    (((r + 2) * (∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (t i k) ^ 2)) / (d : ℝ) ^ 2) •
      Matrix.kronecker (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) feature
  Integrable squared μ ∧ Matrix.PosSemidef (upper - (∫ x, squared x ∂μ)) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let μ : Measure E := stdGaussian E
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let R : E → ℝ := fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun j => ((j.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun j k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ j)
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let N := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let G : E → M := fun x => Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp x)
  let weighted : E → M := fun x => R x • G x
  let feature : M := Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)
  let S : ℝ := ∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (t i k) ^ 2
  let c : ℝ := S / (d : ℝ) ^ 2
  let good : Set E := {y | R y ≤ L}
  let Y : E → N := good.indicator (fun x => (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (G x) feature)
  let squared : E → N := fun x => Y x * Y x
  let upper : N := (((r + 2) * S) / (d : ℝ) ^ 2) • Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) feature
  let tensor : M →ₗ[ℝ] N :=
    (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear : M →ₗ[ℝ] M →ₗ[ℝ] N).flip feature
  let scaled : M →L[ℝ] N := c • tensor.toContinuousLinearMap
  let W : E → N := fun x => scaled (weighted x)
  have moment := actual_radial_fourth_moment_matrix (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change Integrable weighted μ ∧ (∫ x, weighted x ∂μ) = (r + 2) • (1 : M) at moment
  have W_integrable : Integrable W μ := scaled.integrable_comp moment.1
  have good_measurable : MeasurableSet good := by
    dsimp [good, R]
    exact measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) measurable_const

  -- The two rank-one square identities give the exact source matrix square.
  have rank_square (v : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
      Matrix.vecMulVec v v * Matrix.vecMulVec v v =
        (∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (v k) ^ 2) • Matrix.vecMulVec v v := by
    rw [Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_smul]
    congr 1
    simp [dotProduct, pow_two]
  have gram_square (x : E) : G x * G x = R x • G x := by
    have h := rank_square (WithLp.ofLp x)
    have radius_sum : (∑ k : Fin (q + 1), (x k) ^ 2) = R x :=
      (EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq x).symm
    simpa only [radius_sum] using h
  have feature_square : feature * feature = S • feature := rank_square (t i)
  have squared_as_indicator : squared = good.indicator W := by
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ good
    · simp only [squared, Y, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      change ((d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (G x) feature) *
        ((d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (G x) feature) =
          c • Matrix.kronecker (R x • G x) feature
      dsimp only [Matrix.kronecker]
      rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul,
        gram_square x, feature_square]
      ext a b
      change (d : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((d : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ((R x * G x a.1 b.1) * (S * feature a.2 b.2))) =
          c * ((R x * G x a.1 b.1) * feature a.2 b.2)
      dsimp [c]
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring
    · simp [squared, Y, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
  have squared_integrable : Integrable squared μ := by
    rw [squared_as_indicator]
    exact W_integrable.indicator good_measurable

steps.title: Remove the indicator in positive semidefinite order
steps.text: The untruncated matrix W is a nonnegative multiple of the tensor vector outer product. Hence W minus the truncated square is positive semidefinite at every point. The PSD cone is closed and convex, so its integrable residual has PSD expectation. Transport the exact producer mean through the same fixed linear map to obtain the displayed upper matrix.
steps.lean:
-- W is a nonnegative multiple of the tensor vector's rank-one matrix.
  have W_positive (x : E) : (W x).PosSemidef := by
    let v : Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun a => x a.1 * t i a.2
    have rank_positive : (Matrix.vecMulVec v v).PosSemidef := by
      simpa only [star_trivial] using Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star v
    have W_rank : W x = (c * R x) • Matrix.vecMulVec v v := by
      ext a b
      change c * (R x * (x a.1 * x b.1) * (t i a.2 * t i b.2)) =
        (c * R x) * ((x a.1 * t i a.2) * (x b.1 * t i b.2))
      ring
    rw [W_rank]
    apply rank_positive.smul
    exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
      (sq_nonneg (d : ℝ))) (sq_nonneg ‖x‖)
  have residual_positive (x : E) : (W x - squared x).PosSemidef := by
    rw [squared_as_indicator]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ good
    · simpa [Set.indicator_of_mem hx] using (Matrix.PosSemidef.zero : (0 : N).PosSemidef)
    · simpa [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx] using W_positive x

  -- Finite-dimensional PSD matrices form a closed convex set, so their integral is PSD.
  have PSD_closed : IsClosed {A : N | A.PosSemidef} := by
    have hermitian_closed : IsClosed {A : N | A.IsHermitian} := by
      change IsClosed {A : N | star A = A}
      exact isClosed_eq continuous_star continuous_id
    have quadratic_closed (v : (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) → ℝ) :
        IsClosed {A : N | 0 ≤ dotProduct (star v) (Matrix.mulVec A v)} := by
      apply isClosed_le continuous_const
      change Continuous (fun A : N => ∑ a, star (v a) * ∑ b, A a b * v b)
      fun_prop
    convert hermitian_closed.inter (isClosed_iInter quadratic_closed) using 1
    ext A
    simp [Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
  have PSD_convex : Convex ℝ {A : N | A.PosSemidef} := by
    intro A hA B hB a b ha hb hab
    exact (hA.smul ha).add (hB.smul hb)
  have integrated_residual : (∫ x, W x - squared x ∂μ).PosSemidef :=
    PSD_convex.integral_mem PSD_closed (Filter.Eventually.of_forall residual_positive)
      (W_integrable.sub squared_integrable)
  have W_mean : (∫ x, W x ∂μ) = upper := by
    calc
      (∫ x, W x ∂μ) = scaled (∫ x, weighted x ∂μ) :=
        scaled.integral_comp_comm moment.1
      _ = scaled ((r + 2) • (1 : M)) := congrArg scaled moment.2
      _ = upper := by
        change c • Matrix.kronecker ((r + 2) • (1 : M)) feature =
          (((r + 2) * S) / (d : ℝ) ^ 2) • Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) feature
        dsimp only [Matrix.kronecker]
        rw [Matrix.smul_kronecker, smul_smul]
        congr 1
        dsimp [c]
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
        ring
  rw [integral_sub W_integrable squared_integrable, W_mean] at integrated_residual
  change Integrable squared μ ∧ (upper - ∫ x, squared x ∂μ).PosSemidef
  exact ⟨squared_integrable, integrated_residual⟩

end AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityFixedSpectrumRadialFourthMoment
